# 更新说明 · v0.7.0

本版加了两件能力：**读设计稿上的评论**（人话需求的来源）与**生成可直接粘贴的代码**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.0">新增功能</h3>

- **读评论 / 标注**：`read_blocks` 末尾新增「评论」段 —— 设计稿上人类留的话（如「要个png的图片」）
  是需求来源，以前读不到。每条评论会**映射回它落在哪个块**（用评论坐标 × 画板尺寸再匹配块几何），
  命中不了就明说"未落在任何块上"，不硬套；**只读**，从不改/删评论或标记已读。
  有评论时标题行会提示「本稿有 N 条评论（含未读 M）」。
- **代码生成 `lanhu_gen_code`**：从设计稿生成**可直接粘贴的 CSS / WXSS**，`target: web`（px）/ `mini`（rpx）。
  每块一个可读类名，覆盖渐变（角度+全部 stop+小数百分比）、多层阴影（含 inset）、text-shadow、
  backdrop-filter、opacity、四值圆角、实色与渐变边框（后者走 `border-image`）、字体族、富文本 `<span>` 分段、旋转。
- **比蓝湖「代码」面板多做的三处**（照抄它会画错）：
  ① 椭圆图元它给 `border-radius: 0` → 会画成方形环，我们给 `50%`；
  ② 渐变文字它只给 `background` → 会画成文字背后的色块，我们补 `background-clip:text` + `text-fill-color:transparent`；
  ③ 渐变描边必须走 `border-image`。
  另有几处它自身写法不一致的地方，我们定了统一规则（圆角一律四值、`font-weight` 一律数值）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.0">升级注意</h3>

- ⚠️ **`lanhu_list_designs` / `lanhu_search` 现在默认分页**（默认 50 条、硬上限 500，新增 `offset`）。
  以前会一次返回全量；文本里会写明"本页 M / 共 N；下一页传 `offset=X`"。**内部端点与 CLI 仍是全量**。
- ⚠️ **`lanhu_gen_code` 默认只返回可粘贴的 `text`**；结构化的 `codes` 要传 `structured: true` 才给
  （此前两者都返回，同一份 CSS 给两遍）。
- ⚠️ **Sketch 插件格式（`type: sketchPlugin`）的输出有两处变化**：补上了**旋转**（此前一律不出
  `transform`）与**文字多段样式**（`font.styles[]` 此前只取第一段）。
- `read_blocks` 的返回新增 `comments` / `commentsError`；评论读取失败**不会**让整次读取失败。
- 工具数 17 → **18**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.0">问题修复</h3>

- **自检会因为管道截断而"假红"**：`selfcheck` 输出超过 64KB 时，收尾的 `process.exit()` 会在写完之前退出，
  末尾的「合计」行被丢掉 —— 上游解析出 null，看似测试挂了。已改用 `process.exitCode`，并加了回归断言。
- **面板浮层的投影是写死色值**，深色皮肤下不对。已改走官方浮层令牌 `--dsw-elevation-panel`（带原值兜底）。
- **Sketch 插件格式的阴影/模糊字段名与 Figma 不同**（`blurRadius`/`offsetX`/`offsetY`、模糊类型写中文「背景模糊」），
  导致发光阴影**整条丢失**、毛玻璃被写成模糊元素自己 —— 输出合法但结果是错的。已修。
- **截断提示指向了错误的取数通道**：`read_design` 摘要里写"用 `format=full` 取全量"，而 `full` 是落盘留档、
  不是取数通道。现在全项目 23 条截断提示都点名**真参数**（`region` / `limit` / `audit.maxRows` 等）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.0">其他变更</h3>

- **模型面去重**：系统提示与工具定义里同一事实说多遍（换算公式 4 遍、决策树复述 5 个工具的产出清单等）
  → 首轮提示 **21127 → 19177 字符（−9.2%）**。工具行为与返回**一个字节未变**。
- 新增文档：`docs/评论.md`、`docs/生成代码.md`；`docs/读稿.md` 补"支持与不支持的稿件格式"。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.6.1...v0.7.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.6.1...v0.7.0)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.7.0">New Features</h3>

- **Read comments / annotations**: `read_blocks` gains a "Comments" section — comments are where humans state
  requirements (e.g. "I want a PNG here") and were previously unreadable. Each comment is **mapped back to the block
  it falls on** (comment coordinates × artboard size, matched against block geometry); when nothing matches it says so
  instead of forcing a block. **Read-only** — comments are never modified, deleted or marked read. A title-line hint
  appears when a design has comments.
- **Code generation `lanhu_gen_code`**: produce **paste-ready CSS / WXSS** (`target: web` px / `mini` rpx). One readable
  class per block, covering gradients (angle + all stops + fractional percentages), multi-layer shadows (incl. `inset`),
  `text-shadow`, `backdrop-filter`, `opacity`, four-value radii, solid and gradient borders (the latter via `border-image`),
  font families, rich-text `<span>` runs and rotation.
- **Three things it does better than Lanhu's own "Code" panel** (copying that would render wrong):
  ① ellipse primitives get `border-radius: 0` there (renders a square ring) but `50%` here;
  ② gradient text gets only `background` there (renders a colour block) but the full `background-clip`/`text-fill-color`
  treatment here; ③ gradient borders must use `border-image`.

<h3 id="en-v0.7.0">Upgrade Notes</h3>

- ⚠️ **`lanhu_list_designs` / `lanhu_search` now paginate by default** (50 per page, hard cap 500, new `offset`).
  They used to return everything. The text states "page M of N; pass `offset=X` for the next page". **Internal
  endpoints and the CLI still return everything.**
- ⚠️ **`lanhu_gen_code` returns only the paste-ready `text` by default**; the structured `codes` requires
  `structured: true` (both were returned before, duplicating the same CSS).
- ⚠️ **Sketch-plugin designs (`type: sketchPlugin`) change in two ways**: **rotation** is now emitted (it never was)
  and **multi-run text styles** are carried (`font.styles[]` used to contribute only its first run).
- `read_blocks` returns new `comments` / `commentsError` fields; a failed comment fetch never fails the read.
- Tool count 17 → **18**.

<h3 id="en-v0.7.0">Bug Fixes</h3>

- **The self-check could fail spuriously** when its output exceeded the 64 KB pipe buffer: the trailing summary line was
  lost and the upstream parsed `null`. Switched to `process.exitCode`, with a regression assertion.
- **The panel's overlay shadow was a hard-coded colour** (wrong in dark themes) — now uses the platform token
  `--dsw-elevation-panel` with the old value as fallback.
- **Sketch-plugin shadow/blur field names differ from Figma's** (`blurRadius`/`offsetX`/`offsetY`, blur type spelled in
  Chinese), which **dropped glow shadows entirely** and turned backdrop blur into blurring the element itself. Fixed.
- **A truncation hint pointed at the wrong retrieval channel** (`format=full`, which is an archive dump, not a data
  channel). All 23 truncation hints now name a real parameter.

<h3 id="en-v0.7.0">Chores</h3>

- **Model-facing de-duplication**: the same fact was stated repeatedly across the system prompt and tool definitions
  → first-turn prompt **21,127 → 19,177 characters (−9.2%)**. Tool behaviour and returns are **byte-for-byte unchanged**.
- New docs: `docs/评论.md`, `docs/生成代码.md`.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.6.1...v0.7.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.6.1...v0.7.0)
